answers.question: Do you see the new guild structure in the Bloody Endeavor I
answers.normalized: do you see the new guild structure in the bloody endeavor i
answers.answer: Faction index for Bloody Endeavor: Wyrm Bane — the party itself; named in Session 15 after freeing the copper dragon Saildreith. Active members: Albross, Caelion, Lucerion, Pagern, Rhody Falco. Monks of Iohir (The Cold Breath Cult) — fanatical monks led by Master Huldi (The Cold Breath); seek to assemble the Rimestone and cause a new ice age, ostensibly to re-seal an eldritch aberration.

answers.question: Can you give me a brief rundown of what Heroes of Emberstran has been doing?
answers.normalized: can you give me a brief rundown of what heroes of emberstran has been doing
answers.answer: The Heroes of Emberstran are official investigators operating under the Emberstran Guard Detail—though their authority rests on a precarious foundation. Ainslie and Og began with self-made observer badges; after they cleared the Vintner's Guild cellar blight and the Baltwood blight, Emlee and Haggis delivered an official scroll at the Warm Bear Inn.
